opening.argument: The frame pairs displayed earning figures with a direct recruitment route: it shows 15.6 BUSD in INR 1240/- and profits of 30.2 BUSD, then tells viewers to sign up with an upline and prominently directs them to fill a form beside a Bitly link. That combination makes the opportunity an active solicitation, not merely a description of Forsage. The title also identifies Forsage while emphasizing the absence of a conventional company, product, closing process, or administrator. Read together, these details support the position that the video promotes a Forsage-linked, recruitment-oriented earning opportunity through an external sign-up form and link.
